title: In the Exynos modem's IMS stack, improper handling of SDP payload leads to a Denial of Service (CVE-2026-48179)
description: A vulnerability in the Exynos modem's IMS stack involves improper handling of SDP payloads, which can cause a Denial of Service (DoS). This flaw is identified as CVE-2026-48179. No specific affected versions or patches are provided in the available data.
